cards.title: Hour 14 drives the error incident
cards.detail: Hour 14 recorded 1,460 errors in 9,225 requests, a 15.8% error rate and 67.3% of all 2,169 weekly errors. Other high-volume hours recorded 31 errors in 8,899 requests each, so investigate traffic and dependencies at hour 14.

cards.title: caller-07 has a disproportionate cost per request
cards.detail: caller-07 spent $174.12 on 1,180 requests, or $0.148 per request, versus $0.016 per request across all 204,993 requests. It represents 0.6% of requests but 5.2% of the $3,354.82 weekly spend.

cards.title: Low-cache callers are a material optimization target
cards.detail: Ten callers with cache-hit rates from 3.7% to 8.9% generated 44,951 requests and $849.66 in spend, 21.9% of requests and 25.3% of total spend. Their weighted cache-hit rate is 6.6%; review their cache keys and cache eligibility.

cards.title: model-alpha has the highest p95 latency at high volume
cards.detail: model-alpha processed 86,080 requests, 42.0% of total volume, with a 2,454 ms p95 latency. This exceeds model-beta at 2,229 ms, model-delta at 1,689 ms, and model-gamma at 1,310 ms; prioritize latency investigation or routing alternatives for alpha traffic.

cards.title: caller-01 is the dominant client
cards.detail: caller-01 generated 105,832 requests, 51.6% of all requests, and $1,643.86 in spend, 49.0% of the total. Changes affecting this caller have the largest impact on weekly usage and cost.
